body.statement: There exists \(\theta_0\in\Theta_S\) with rational positive entries such that \(\operatorname{rank}M_{\theta_0}=Q_S-\kappa_0(S)-\eta(S)\). Moreover, \(r_{\mathrm{gen}}(S)=Q_S-\kappa_0(S)-\eta(S)\), and the same rank holds on a nonempty relative Zariski-open, Euclidean-dense, full-Lebesgue-measure subset of \(\Theta_S\). If \(\kappa_0(S)+\eta(S)>0\), then \(\operatorname{rank}M_\theta<Q_S\) for every \(\theta\in\Theta_S\).
body.justification: The formula separates forced constant-direction loss from the genuine quotient Hall defect and converts an abstract rank upper bound into compatible positive tables.
body.gap: Miao, Geng, and Tchetgen Tchetgen require categorical proxy rank, and the banked rectangular result treats equal alphabets with full support; neither gives rank from an arbitrary declared support.
body.consumer: An analyst can determine whether the fortified outcome-completeness route is generically feasible or impossible at every compatible positive law before fitting bridge models.
